summary: Retest of 'Run autopilot now' axios timeout fix. Verified the fix is in place in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js line 366 (api.post('/ops/outbound/autopilot-now', auth, { timeout: 180000 })). Verified backend endpoint works (curl returns 200 in ~5.5s with current 0-unscored state). HOWEVER, end-to-end Playwright validation of the UI button could not be completed: across 3 separate runs and 4 different click strategies (Playwright .click(), .click(force=True), JS-dispatched btn.click(), and direct React onClick invocation via reactProps), NO network request was emitted and NO toast (success or failure) appeared. Backend logs confirm zero autopilot-now POSTs from any of my Playwright test sessions, while a manual curl from the same shell DID land. The button is verified visible, not disabled, no overlay (elementFromPoint === button), and React onClick handler is bound. This appears to be a headless-browser interaction quirk with this specific click handler — NOT a regression of the timeout fix.

integration_issues.issue: Could not trigger the click programmatically in headless Chromium across 4 strategies. The button has data-testid='outbound-run-tick', is visible, not disabled, no overlay, and has a bound React onClick (verified via reactProps inspection). Yet the runTick handler never fires (no axios call observed in browser network listener AND no POST /api/ops/outbound/autopilot-now in backend access logs from the test). A manual curl call to the same endpoint with identical auth payload returns 200 OK in ~5.5s, so backend is healthy. Likely Playwright/React event-delegation interaction issue specific to this setup. Recommended: main agent verify manually in a real browser at /portal/ops → Outbound → click 'Run autopilot now'. Code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/PortalOpsPage.jsx lines 1460-1473 and /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js line 366 shows the implementation is correct.

action_items: Main agent: manually verify in a real browser tab that clicking 'Run autopilot now' on /portal/ops → Outbound now produces a green 'Autopilot complete · seeded N · scored M · sent X' toast within ~10s (current backend state has 0 unscored prospects so cycle is fast).

Code is correct: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js line 366 has timeout: 180000 override; runTick handler in PortalOpsPage.jsx lines 1460-1473 correctly awaits opsOutboundAutopilotNow and calls toast.success on resolve / toast.error on reject; backend curl to /api/ops/outbound/autopilot-now responds 200 in ~5.5s.

If main agent's manual browser test ALSO fails (no toast, no network call), check whether 'busy' state from another action is leaving the button in a stale-disabled state, or whether auth token state-prop is null at click time.
critical_code_review_comments: Per-call axios timeout override is the right surgical fix (vs raising the global 30s default). Cleanly contained to opsOutboundAutopilotNow.
runTick handler at /app/frontend/src/pages/PortalOpsPage.jsx:1460 has correct try/catch/finally with setBusy reset — good.

Recommend adding a small busy-spinner indicator inside the 'Run autopilot now' button label when busy=true so users know the cycle is running (currently button just disables without text change — for a 5-60s call this is poor UX).
